body.name: Jade Pincer
body.notes: The Jade Pincer is a scorpion that has surpassed the natural boundaries of its own kind. Way bigger, stronger and faster than ordinary scorpions, it makes a perfect companion for fearless heroes and explorers. Just be careful of his poisonous sting when you mount it.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Donkey
body.notes:
Go to [[Incredibly Old Witch]]'s house, {{Mapper Coords|125.250|126.95|7|2|text=here}}, then lure any wild creature and wait until the witch turns it into a Donkey. Use a [[Bag of Apple Slices]] on the changed creature before it's changed again. You can also trap the Incredibly Old Witch and use the Bag when she transforms herself. It's recommended to put the Bag of Apple Slices on a hotkey so when a creature is changed to Donkey you just need to press it instead of clicking the item and then the Donkey.
If you tame the donkey by using the item on the witch herself (while she is transformed into Donkey), she will temporarily vanish, and respawns about 10 minutes later.
On most game worlds it's the cheapest mount to obtain, what makes it popular among low or mid levels who want to gain additional 10 points of speed. Donkey (Transformation).gif|Donkey (transformed creature)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Bag of Apple Slices]] on a creature transformed into Donkey.

body.name: Feral Tiger
body.notes: It is said that in ancient times, the sabre-tooth tiger was already used as a mount by elder warriors of Svargrond. As seafaring began to expand, this noble big cat was also transported to other regions in Tibia. Influenced by the new environment and climatic changes, the fur of the Feral Tiger has developed its extraordinary colouring over several generations.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8129|Dec 20, 2024}} and was the first implementation from the {{OfficialNewsArchive|7931|Store Ensemble Contest}} which was submitted by {{Character|Skogul The Giant}} who secured the first place in the voting.
body.name: Pallbearer
body.notes:
The Pallbearer is more than a vehicle; it is a sinister statement on wheels. A luxurious hearse for those special occasions when you need to send a chilling message to your adversaries. Ideal for you and those you would rather see on the other side.

[[File:Field Surgeon Bundle Banner.png]]
Purchasing this [[Mounts|Mount]] through the [[Field Surgeon Bundle]] can save you 420 [[Tibia Coins]] instead of buying each of the items separately.

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.56|Update 10.56]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Woodland Prince
body.notes: Once captured and held captive by a mad hunter, the Woodland Prince is the result of sick experiments. Fed only with demon dust and concentrated demonic blood it had to endure a dreadful transformation. The demonic blood that is now running through its veins, however, provides it with incredible strength and endurance.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Uniwheel
body.notes:
The [[Uniwheel (Object)|Uniwheel object]] is located in the [[Yielothax Dimension]], accessed during [[The Mage's Tower]] world change. It can be found {{Mapper Coords|128.171|123.95|9|4|text=here}}.

Before [[Updates/9.2]], it wasn't possible to access the room containing the the Uniwheel — due to a map bug, the stairs to the floor it's located didn't exist.
<gallery mode="nolines">Uniwheel.png|Uniwheel room</gallery>
body.taming_method: Use a [[Golden Can of Oil]] on a [[Uniwheel (Object)|stationary Uniwheel]].

body.name: Dragonling (Mount)
body.notes: It is a tamed [[Dragonling]].
body.taming_method: Use [[Decorative Ribbon]] or [[Music Box]] on a [[Dragonling]].

body.name: Landsailer

body.name: Jousting Eagle
body.notes:
High above the clouds far away from dry land, the training of giant eagles takes place. Only the cream of the crop is able to survive in such harsh environment long enough to call themselves Jousting Eagles while the weaklings find themselves at the bottom of the sea. The tough ones become noble and graceful mounts that are well known for their agility and endurance.
[[File:Jousting Eagle (Standing).gif|thumb|left|Idle Animation]]

body.name: Djinntaur
body.notes:
The Djinntaur combines brute strength with supernatural swagger. It charges with unstoppable force, yet carries itself with an almost regal confidence. Few creatures inspire equal measures of awe, confusion, and the sudden urge to run.

Purchasing this [[Mounts|Mount]] through the [[Broken Moon Bundle]] can save you 420 [[Tibia Coins]] instead of buying each of the items separately.

body.name: Dawn Strayer
body.notes: A magical fire burns inside these wolves. Bred as the faithful guardians for an eccentric wizard's tower, these creatures make for loyal companions during your travels. While not originally intended for riding, their sturdy frame makes the Dawn Strayer, Dusk Pryer and Snow Strider suitable mounts.

body.name: Leaf Locust
body.notes:
Born from the buzzing chaos of nature's most untamed corners, the [[Night Locust]], [[Leaf Locust]], and [[Pearl Locust]] are said to be harbingers of fortune for their allies and heralds of despair for their foes. With their vibrant wings and shimmering shells, these eerie yet majestic creatures are exceptional mounts for adventurers who thrive in the wilds.

[[File:Leaf_Locust_Banner.jpg]]

body.notes: The Festive Mammoth, Holiday Mammoth and Merry Mammoth are gentle giants with a massive appearance and impressive tusks, whose mission it is to deliver gifts all across Tibia. They are good-natured beings, spreading joy wherever they go, but you best not cross them - a mammoth never forgets.

body.name: Poppy Ibex
body.notes: No mountain is too high, no wall too steep to climb for the agile Poppy, Mint and Cinnamon Ibex. They keep their balance on the thinnest of ledges, so you will never stumble, slip or go flying off the edges. Moreover, these sturdy fellows certainly know how to make an entrance as they dive down from the highest peaks and attack opponents with their impressive horns. And if you dare to call them a wild goat, they might kick you with their legs.

body.notes:
Its achievement is shared with the other Rolling Barrel Mounts ([[Blue Rolling Barrel|Blue]] and [[Green Rolling Barrel|Green]]). If you have more than one type of sheet, the first one in your inventory will be consumed and the respective mount obtained. Also, you'll need one [[Beer Tap]] for each Barrel mount. When obtaining this mount, you receive the following message:
{{Server Message|It's tapped! You now own your very own red rolling barrel! Have fun - it's an Orger tradition}}

body.name: Wrathfire Pegasus
body.notes:
The Wrathfire Pegasus is a fearsome mount, inspiring terror in all that is vile and heathen! Its flaming wings and crimson mane blaze like a wildfire, striking fear and panic into the hearts of your enemies. Leave a scorching impression on both foes and friends alike. Unleash your wrath, and ride this infernal beast to victory over the ashes of your enemies!

The Wrathfire Pegasus has a standing animation shown here: [[File:Wrathfire Pegasus Standing.gif]]

body.name: Corpse Phoenix
body.notes: Corpse Phoenix, Death Phoenix, and Soul Phoenix are messengers from another world. They carry the experience of countless battles - and some of the toughest bones you will ever face. Ride on the wings of death!

body.name: Gloom Widow
body.notes: It is said that the Gloom Widow was born long before Banor walked the earth of Tibia. While its parents died in the war against the cruel hordes sent by Brog and Zathroth, their child survived by hiding in skulls of burned enemies. It never left its hiding spot and as it grew older, the skulls merged into its body. Now, it is fully-grown and thirsts for revenge.

body.name: Wolpertinger
body.notes:
Do you like fluffy bunnies but think they are too small? Do you admire the majesty of stags and their antlers but are afraid of their untameable wilderness? Do not worry, the mystic creature Wolpertinger consolidates the best qualities of both animals. Hop on its backs and enjoy the ride.
[[File:Jackalope Dreadhare Wolpertinger Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]

body.notes: Badgers have been a staple of the Tibian fauna for a long time, and finally some daring souls have braved the challenge to tame some exceptional specimens - and succeeded! While the common badger you can encounter during your travels might seem like a rather unassuming creature, the Battle Badger, the Ether Badger, and the Zaoan Badger are fierce and mighty beasts, which are at your beck and call.

body.notes: These creatures are Floating Savants whose mind has been warped and bent to focus their extraordinary mental capabilities on one single goal: to do their master's bidding. Instead of being filled with an endless pursuit of knowledge, their live is now one of continuous thralldom and serfhood. The Floating Sage, the Floating Scholar and the Floating Augur are at your disposal.

body.name: The Hellgrip
body.notes:
In order to tame a gravedigger (located in [[Drefia]]) to mount it you must first have completed [[The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest]]. After this you must then use the [[Nail Case]] a total of five times, once per finger, in a row successfully. It's believed that waiting a few moments between uses increases the chances of taming. You can fail at any finger. Also, note that the Nail Case will not break.
Succeeding: # ''You carefully cut the nail of the gravedigger's thumb.'' # ''You successfully manicured the forefinger of the gravedigger.'' # ''You successfully manicured the middlefinger of the gravedigger.'' # ''You actually manicured the ring finger of the gravedigger without a problem.'' # ''You did it! A completely manicured gravedigger is ready to follow you as your own personal trusty mount until the bitter end!'' Failing: ''You failed to manicure the nails of the sensitive gravedigger. Before you can make amends, the creature runs away in agony.''

body.name: Gloothomotive
body.notes: The [[Wind-Up Key]], the secondary item needed for the mount, was also obtainable during the [[Tibia's 25th Anniversary]] [[Lucky Dragon]] minigame. As of now, it can only be acquired through [[Retros Treasure]].

body.notes: The Poisonbane is out searching for the best bamboo in Tibia. Its heavy armour allows it to visit even the most dangerous places. Treat it nicely with its favourite food from time to time and it will become a loyal partner.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Benevolent Savanna Ostrich
body.notes:
This is one of the first mounts bought with [[Tibia Coins]] that are assigned to all characters on the account.

This mount could be bought in the Store from April 17 till April 31, 2020. From June 2020 onwards, a new version of this mount - [[Savanna Ostrich]] - is available in the [[Store]] which will be assigned only to the character used when purchasing the mount.

The entire proceeds gained from the sale of this and the other benevolent mounts, which was {{OfficialNewsArchive|5595|about 166,000€}}, went towards the COVID-19 Solidarity Response Fund of the World Health Organization (WHO).
body.taming_method: Buy it from the [[Store]] in a specific period of time.

body.name: Jousting Horse
body.notes:
A seasoned warrior knows how to make an entry, and so does his faithful companion: Fully armored! Saddle up your impressive Jousting Horse to charge into battle in style, gallop into the arena on the back of your striking Tourney Horse, and ride your distinguished Parade Horse through the streets of Thais to show off your chivalrous qualities. With a horse in full barding, nobody will ever rain on your parade again.
[[File:Jousting Horse Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]

body.notes: The Razorcreep has external characteristics of different breeds. It is assumed that his brain is also composed of many different species, which makes it completely unpredictable. Only few have managed to approach this creature unharmed and only the best could tame it.

Like all extra content (outfits, mounts zones, etc.) you need a premium account to use mounts, even after being tamed. File:Teaser 2 Black Sheep.png|[[Black Sheep (Mount)]]

body.name: Steelbeak
body.notes: Forged by only the highest skilled blacksmiths in the depths of Kazordoon's furnaces, a wild animal made out of the finest steel arose from glowing embers and blazing heat. Protected by its impenetrable armour, the Steelbeak is ready to accompany its master on every battleground.

body.name: River Crocovile
body.notes: To the keen observer, the crocovile is clearly a relative of the crocodile, albeit their look suggests an even more aggressive nature. While it is true that the power of its massive and muscular body can not only crush enemies dead but also break through any gate like a battering ram, a crocovile is, above all, a steadfast companion showing unwavering loyalty to its owner

body.name: Tangerine Flecked Koi
body.notes: The vibrant colours and elegance of a Tangerine Flecked Koi, a Brass Speckled Koi, and an Ink Spotted Koi make them a fascinating sight to behold, and their boisterous nature and speed will make you the first to arrive wherever there are riches to gain. Wield your weapon as gracefully and effortlessly as your swimming companion glides through the water, and the two of you will make the perfect and most deadly pair.

body.name: Glooth Glider
body.notes:
To build this mount you'll need 7 items looted from bosses of the [[Oramond Factory Raids]] and of the [[Hero of Rathleton Quest]]. You must also have completed 4 specific tasks in the [[Oramond Quest]] at least once before building the Glooth Glider. Once you obtain the [[Glooth Glider Blueprint]], you can use it to check what items and tasks you still require to complete the mount. '''Note that you can only build the mount if you have completed the [[Hero of Rathleton Quest]], simply buying the items isn't enough.'''

You need '''1 of each''' of the following items to construct the Glooth Glider:

* {{Ilink|Roll of Covering}} [[Roll of Covering]] from [[Moohtant Wallbreaker]]
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Gear Wheel}} [[Glooth Glider Gear Wheel]] from [[Glooth Bomb]]
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Crank}} [[Glooth Glider Crank]] from [[Tremor Worm]]
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Tubes and Wires}} [[Glooth Glider Tubes and Wires]] from [[Deep Terror]]
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Hinge}} [[Glooth Glider Hinge]] from the [[Empowered Glooth Horror]]s
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Casing}} [[Glooth Glider Casing]] from [[Professor Maxxen]]
* {{Ilink|Glooth Glider Blueprint}} [[Glooth Glider Blueprint]] as a reward from the [[Hero of Rathleton Quest]]

These tasks must have been completed at least once:

* [[Oramond Quest/Spoiler#The Mutated Glooth Plague|The Mutated Glooth Plague]]
* [[Oramond Quest/Spoiler#Four Demanding Statues|Four Demanding Statues]]
* [[Oramond Quest/Spoiler#Tending Gloothworms|Tending Gloothworms]]
* [[Oramond Quest/Spoiler#Nature's Balance|Nature's Balance]]
* [[Oramond Quest/Spoiler#The Gloud Ship|The Gloud Ship]]

Once you have collected all the required items and completed all the tasks, locate [[Peremin]] in the [[Underground Glooth Factory]], {{Mapper Coords|131.15|124.219|14|4|text=here}}, and ask him to {{KW|build}} the mount for you, then say {{KW|yes}}.
body.taming_method: Obtain its 7 parts, finish 4 tasks of the [[Oramond Quest]] and then talk to NPC [[Peremin]].

body.notes: Its roaring is piercing marrow and bone and can be heard over ten miles away. The Desert King is the undisputed ruler of its territory and no one messes with this animal. Show no fear and prove yourself worthy of its trust and you will get yourself a valuable companion for your adventures.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Gloomwurm
body.notes: The Bogwurm, Gloomwurm, and Rustwurm belong to a little known subset of the dragon family, and usually live out their lives in habitats far away from human interaction. Them being cunning hunters, and their keen sense of perception make these wurms great companions for whomever can locate and tame them.

body.taming_method: Use a [[Library Ticket]] on a [[Flying Book]].

body.notes: Owls have always been a symbol of mystery, magic and wisdom in Tibian myths and fairy tales. Having one of these enigmatic creatures of the night as a trustworthy companion provides you with a silent guide whose ever-watchful eyes will cut through the shadows, help you navigate the darkness and unravel great secrets.

body.name: Gorongra
body.notes: Get yourself a mighty travelling companion with broad shoulders and a gentle heart. Gorongra is a physically imposing creature that is much more peaceful than its relatives, Tiquanda's wild kongras, and will carry you safely wherever you ask it to go.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Lacewing Moth (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Turquoise Tendril Lantern]] on a [[Lacewing Moth]].

body.history: It can be bought since [[Updates/10.56|Update 10.56]].
body.name: Blackpelt
body.notes: The Blackpelt is out searching for the best bamboo in Tibia. Its heavy armour allows it to visit even the most dangerous places. Treat it nicely with its favourite food from time to time and it will become a loyal partner.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Shellodon
body.notes: You must have finished the [[Too Hot to Handle Quest]] to obtain this mount.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3433|December 23, 2015}}.
body.name: Nightdweller
body.notes:
If you are more of an imp than an angel, you may prefer riding out on a Nightdweller to scare fellow Tibians on their festive strolls. Its devilish mask, claw-like hands and sharp hooves makes it the perfect companion for any daring adventurer who likes to stand out.
[[File:Idle Nightdweller.gif|thumb|left|Idle Animation]]

body.name: Walker (Mount)
body.notes: To obtain this mount, use a [[Control Unit]] on a [[Walker]]. Note: The [[Control Unit]] has a chance of breaking when used.

body.history: Although this mount was implemented on [[Updates/11.50|Update 11.50]], the achievement was only implemented on [[Updates/11.53|Update 11.53]].
body.name: Mole (Mount)
body.notes: It's a tamed [[Mole]].

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3039|December 18, 2014}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Floating Kashmir
body.notes: The Floating Kashmir is the perfect mount for those who are too busy to take care of an animal mount or simply like to travel on a beautiful, magic hand-woven carpet.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8236|February 21, 2025}}.
body.name: Pearl Locust
body.notes: Born from the buzzing chaos of nature's most untamed corners, the [[Night Locust]], [[Leaf Locust]], and [[Pearl Locust]] are said to be harbingers of fortune for their allies and heralds of despair for their foes. With their vibrant wings and shimmering shells, these eerie yet majestic creatures are exceptional mounts for adventurers who thrive in the wilds.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4994|May 10, 2019}} while it had been implemented one month before that, with [[Updates/12.12.8341|Update 12.12.8341]].
body.name: Nightmarish Crocovile
body.notes: To the keen observer, the crocovile is clearly a relative of the crocodile, albeit their look suggests an even more aggressive nature. While it is true that the power of its massive and muscular body can not only crush enemies dead but also break through any gate like a battering ram, a crocovile is, above all, a steadfast companion showing unwavering loyalty to its owner.

body.name: Midnight Panther (Mount)
body.notes:
You may need to use the [[Leather Whip]] more than once since you might get a message saying that "{{Sound|The midnight panther is growling at you.}}"
<noinclude><gallery widths="221" heights="221" orientation="landscape" navigation="true" mode="nolines">
Teaser 2 Midnight Panther.png|[[Midnight Panther]]
</gallery></noinclude>
body.taming_method: Use a [[Leather Whip]] or a [[Music Box]] on a [[Midnight Panther]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|5198|November 18, 2019}}.
body.name: Floating Scholar
body.notes: These creatures are Floating Savants whose mind has been warped and bent to focus their extraordinary mental capabilities on one single goal: to do their master's bidding. Instead of being filled with an endless pursuit of knowledge, their live is now one of continuous thralldom and serfhood. The Floating Sage, the Floating Scholar and the Floating Augur are at your disposal.

body.name: Foxmouse (Mount)
body.notes: Foxmice can only be tamed by players who are not cursed by the were sickness. Make sure to use {{ilink|Purple Nightshade Blossoms}} [[Purple Nightshade Blossoms]] in case you are sick.

body.name: Scorpion King
body.taming_method: Use a [[Scorpion Sceptre]] on a [[Sandstone Scorpion]].

body.name: Dark Percht Sleigh Variant
body.notes:
You can only upgrade one year after getting the basic Dark Percht Sleigh. Upgrading to the Variant mount has no benefit other than receiving a new mount with a slightly different visual, however, this is necessary for the [[Finished Dark Percht Sleigh|finished]] improvement of the mount. 

Upgrading the mount is only possible when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.
body.taming_method: Ask [[Frosty]] to upgrade a [[Dark Percht Sleigh]] by delivering another [[Percht Skull]] to him.

body.name: Gnarlhound (Mount)
body.notes: It can be obtained by all players who finished [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].
body.taming_method: Use a [[Golem Wrench]] on a [[Modified Gnarlhound]].

body.name: Tamed Panda
body.notes: One of the cheaper Mounts.
body.taming_method: Use [[Bamboo Leaves]] or a [[Music Box]] on a [[Panda]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7855|May 17, 2024}}.
body.name: Bog Tyrant
body.notes:
These beings are as ancient as the volcanoes, mountains, and caves of Tibia and despite their formidable presence, they skillfully navigate through the tiniest openings the surroundings may offer. Mount up on a [[Glacier Wyrm]], a [[Bog Tyrant]], or a [[Crimson Fang]] and zip to your next duel both swiftly and securely!
[[File:Bog_Tyrant_Banner.jpg]]

body.name: Rift Watcher
body.notes:
If you are looking for a vigilant and faithful companion, look no further! Glide through every realm and stare into the darkest abyss on the back of a Rift Watcher. They already know everything about you anyway for they have been watching you from the shadows!

It also exists in a [[Void Watcher|Blue]] and [[Rune Watcher|Green]] version.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.78|June 8, 2015]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Coralripper
body.notes: If the Coralripper moves its fins, it generates enough air pressure that it can even float over land. Its numerous eyes allow it to quickly detect dangers even in confusing situations and eliminate them with one powerful bite. If you watch your fingers, you are going to be good friends.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on February 26, 2016.
body.name: Bloodcurl
body.notes: You are fascinated by insectoid creatures and can picture yourself riding one during combat or just for travelling? The Bloodcurl will carry you through the Tibian wilderness with ease.

body.name: Satin Moth
body.notes: The Satin Moth is a creature of ethereal grace, embodying the duality of delicacy and inner strength. It is said to symbolise enlightenment itself, carrying its rider towards the ultimate truth in an ever-chaotic world.

body.name: Hibernal Moth (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Purple Tendril Lantern]] on a [[Hibernal Moth]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6307|September 10, 2021}}.
body.name: Bogwurm
body.notes:
The Bogwurm, Gloomwurm, and Rustwurm belong to a little known subset of the dragon family, and usually live out their lives in habitats far away from human interaction. Them being cunning hunters, and their keen sense of perception make these wurms great companions for whomever can locate and tame them.
[[File:Bogwurm Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Winter King
body.notes: Its roaring is piercing marrow and bone and can be heard over ten miles away. The Winter King is the undisputed ruler of its territory and no one messes with this animal. Show no fear and prove yourself worthy of its trust and you will get yourself a valuable companion for your adventures.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Primal Demonosaur
body.notes: Obtained by using a {{Ilink|Demon in a Green Box}} [[Demon in a Green Box]].
body.taming_method: Use a [[Demon in a Green Box]].

body.name: Rune Watcher
body.notes: If you are looking for a vigilant and faithful companion, look no further! Glide through every realm and stare into the darkest abyss on the back of a Rune Watcher. They already know everything about you anyway for they have been watching you from the shadows!
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Flamesteed
body.notes: Once a majestic and proud warhorse, the Flamesteed has fallen in a horrible battle many years ago. Driven by agony and pain, its spirit once again took possession of its rotten corpse to avenge its death. Stronger than ever, it seeks a master to join the battlefield, aiming for nothing but death and destruction.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4236|August 11, 2017}}, but it was already implemented a few weeks earlier with the [[Updates/11.40|Summer Update 2017]].
body.name: Arctic Unicorn
body.notes: The Arctic Unicorn lives in a deep rivalry with its cousin the Blazing Unicorn. Even though they were born in completely different areas, they somehow share the same bloodline. The eternal battle between fire and ice continues. Who will win? Tangerine vs.crystal blue! The choice is yours!
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Snow Strider
body.notes: A magical fire burns inside these wolves. Bred as the faithful guardians for an eccentric wizard's tower, these creatures make for loyal companions during your travels. While not originally intended for riding, their sturdy frame makes the Dawn Strayer, Dusk Pryer and Snow Strider suitable mounts.

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3176|April 30, 2015}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Flitterkatzen
body.notes:
Rumour has it that many years ago elder witches had gathered to hold a magical feast high up in the mountains. They had crossbred Flitterkatzen to easily conquer rocky canyons and deep valleys. Nobody knows what happened on their way up but only the mount has been seen ever since.
[[File:Standing Flitterkatzen.gif|thumb|left|Idle Animation]]
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history:
Previously known as ''Fire War Horse'' by players. While this mount was added to the game with the [[Updates/9.1|Update 9.1]], it was only obtainable during {{OfficialNewsArchive|2162|a special offer}} by buying a unit of 180 or 360 days of premium time between August 29 and September 12, 2012. Buying the premium time only let you assign this mount to one [[character]]. It is possible to follow the offical FAQ made by '''CM Mirade''' {{Post|33520384|here}}.

This mount has been available in the [[Store]] since {{OfficialNewsArchive|4262|September 15, 2017}}.

body.name: Armoured War Horse
body.notes: The Armoured War Horse is a dangerous black beauty! When you see its threatening, blood-red eyes coming towards you, you'll know trouble is on its way. Protected by its heavy armour plates, the warhorse is the perfect partner for dangerous hunting sessions and excessive enemy slaughtering.
body.taming_method: Adding [[Premium Time]] during a specific date or buying it via the [[Store]].

body.name: Manta Ray (Mount)
body.notes: Was implemented at the [[Winter Update 2011]]. First seen in {{OfficialNewsArchive|1596|a poll}}.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6481|December 22, 2021}}.
body.name: Mystic Raven
body.notes: The origins of the Emerald Raven, Mystic Raven, and Radiant Raven are shrouded in darkness, as no written record nor tale told by even the most knowing storytellers mentions but a trace of them. Superstition surrounds them, as some see these gigantic birds as an echo of a long forgotten past, while others believe them to herald hitherto unknown events. What is clear is that they are highly intelligent beings which make great companions if they deem somebody worthy.

body.name: Krakoloss
body.notes:
This is the first Colourisable Mount.

Krakoloss 2.gif
Krakoloss 3.gif

body.taming_method: Defeat [[Tentugly's Head]] during [[A Pirate's Tail Quest]].

body.name: Ironblight (Mount)
body.notes: It is a tamed [[Ironblight]]. It was implemented in the [[Updates/9.6‎|Update 9.6]].
body.taming_method: Use an [[Iron Loadstone]] or a [[Music Box]] on an [[Ironblight]].

body.name: Finished Bright Percht Sleigh
body.notes: It's the final upgrade after the [[Bright Percht Sleigh]] and its [[Bright Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant]]. Upgrading the mount is only possible when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active and one year after getting the Variant mount and one year after getting the Variant mount.
body.taming_method: Ask [[Frosty]] to upgrade a [[Bright Percht Sleigh Variant]] by delivering another [[Percht Skull]] to him.

body.name: Caped Snowman
body.notes: When the nights are getting longer and freezing wind brings driving snow into the land, snowmen rise and shine on every corner. Lately, a peaceful, arcane creature has found shelter in one of them and used its magical power to call the Caped Snowman into being. Wrap yourself up well and warmly and jump on the back of your new frosty companion.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3836|December 23, 2016}}, but it was implemented a couple of months earlier on October 25, 2016 with [[Updates/11.01.3987|11.01.3987]] and [[Updates/10.99|10.99]].
body.name: Jackalope
body.notes: Do you like fluffy bunnies but think they are too small? Do you admire the majesty of stags and their antlers but are afraid of their untameable wilderness? Do not worry, the mystic creature Jackalope consolidates the best qualities of both animals. Hop on its backs and enjoy the ride.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7855|May 17, 2024}}.
body.name: Crimson Fang
body.notes: These beings are as ancient as the volcanoes, mountains, and caves of Tibia and despite their formidable presence, they skillfully navigate through the tiniest openings the surroundings may offer. Mount up on a [[Glacier Wyrm]], a [[Bog Tyrant]], or a [[Crimson Fang]] and zip to your next duel both swiftly and securely!

body.name: War Horse
body.taming_method: Use [[Sugar Oat]] or a [[Music Box]] on a [[Wild Horse]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7731|February 23, 2024}}.
body.name: Skybreaker Pegasus
body.notes:
Majestic and regal, the Skybreaker Pegasus is a manifesto of the covenant between the gods and the faithful! Its noble, golden wings and mane shimmer in remembrance of the divine plane, radiating the light of the heavens. Break through the clouds that shroud the minds of the unenlightened, touch the sky, and captivate hearts as the owner of this celestial beast!

The Skybreaker Pegasus has a standing animation shown here: [[File:Skybreaker Pegasus Standing.gif]]

body.name: Coral Rhea
body.notes:
These birds have a strong maternal instinct since their fledglings are completely dependent on their parents for protection. Do not expect them to abandon their brood only because they are carrying you around. In fact, if you were to separate them from their chick, the Savanna Ostrich, Coral Rhea and Eventide Nandu would turn into vicious beings, so don't even try it!
{{Seealso|Benevolent Coral Rhea}}

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|5860|November 27, 2020}}.
body.name: Holiday Mammoth
body.notes: The Festive Mammoth, Holiday Mammoth and Merry Mammoth are gentle giants with a massive appearance and impressive tusks, whose mission it is to deliver gifts all across Tibia. They are good-natured beings, spreading joy wherever they go, but you best not cross them - a mammoth never forgets.

body.name: Cold Percht Sleigh
body.notes:
The Sleigh can be upgraded to a [[Cold Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant form]].

It can only be obtained when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.

body.name: Giant Beaver (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Colourful Water Lily]] on a [[Giant Beaver]].

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.60 (2)|Update 10.60 (2)]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Highland Yak
body.notes: With its thick, shaggy hair, the Highland Yak will keep you warm even in the chilly climate of the Ice Islands. Due to its calm and peaceful nature, it is not letting itself getting worked up easily.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Rapid Boar
body.notes:
<noinclude><gallery mode="nolines">

</gallery></noinclude>

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3955|March 10, 2017}}, but the sprites were already released with [[Updates/11.10|Update 11.10]]<!-- or before that -->.
body.name: Emerald Sphinx
body.notes: Ride an Emerald Sphinx on your way through ancient chambers and tombs and have a loyal friend by your side while fighting countless mummies and other creatures.

body.name: Bumblebee
body.notes:
This mount is off-the-charts cute! Meet the Bumblebee, your oasis of calmness and sweetness in the wild, war-torn world of Tibia. Sure, this fuzzy friend won't bite, but don't let its peaceful vibes fool you. Criticise its stunning looks or threaten its owner, and out comes the mega-stinger. Who knew cuteness could pack such a punch?

'''Additionally''': This mount can also be obtained by opening a {{Ilink|Sweet Present}} [[Sweet Present]], which also includes the [[Beekeeper Outfits|Beekeeper Outfit]], [[Beehive]], and [[Candy Chest]], and can also be purchased as part of the [[Sweet Honey Bundle]].
body.taming_method: Opening a [[Sweet Present]] or Buying it in the Store.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6188|June 11, 2021}}.
body.name: Peony
body.notes: Born from the depths of the forest, where flora and fauna intertwine in mysterious ways, the Floral Beast is a colourful creature that is sure to turn some heads. The Hyacinth, Peony, and Dandelion mount are loyal companions that will safely carry you through their natural habitat of the woods, or lands unknown to them.

body.name: Death Phoenix
body.notes: Corpse Phoenix, Death Phoenix, and Soul Phoenix are messengers from another world. They carry the experience of countless battles - and some of the toughest bones you will ever face. Ride on the wings of death!

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4521|March 13, 2018}}, but they were already implemented a few months earlier with [[Updates/11.49.6030|Update 11.49.6030]].
body.name: Sanguine Frog
body.notes: For centuries, humans and monsters have dumped their garbage in the swamps around Venore. The combination of old, rusty weapons, stale mana and broken runes have turned some of the swamp dwellers into gigantic frogs. Benefit from those mutations and make the Sanguine Frog a faithful mount for your adventures even beyond the bounds of the swamp.

body.name: Surly Steer
body.notes: Do you love the fresh scent of country air and feel a sense of warmth when you think of a rustic farm? Or do you yearn to harness the raw power of a colossal four-legged friend? If so, then look no further than the Boisterous Bull, the Surly Steer, or the Obstinate Ox. These mounts will be sure to satisfy your needs.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7731|February 23, 2024}}.
body.name: Dawnbringer Pegasus
body.notes:
The Dawnbringer Pegasus is a noble mount of divine inspiration, its radiant wings and shining mane filling pious observers with hope and courage. Rise above the darkness, spread hope, and ride this glorious beast into battle, to smite the servants of evil!

The Dawnbringer Pegasus has a standing animation shown here: [[File:Dawnbringer Pegasus Standing.gif]]

body.notes: It is a tamed [[Magma Crawler]]. It provides a small amount of orange light while riding it.
body.taming_method: Use [[Glow Wine]] or a [[Music Box]] on a [[Magma Crawler]].

body.notes:
Ride a Gold Sphinx on your way through ancient chambers and tombs and have a loyal friend by your side while fighting countless mummies and other creatures.
[[File:Sphinxes Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]

body.name: Blue Rolling Barrel
body.notes:
Its achievement is shared with the other Rolling Barrel Mounts ([[Red Rolling Barrel|Red]] and [[Green Rolling Barrel|Green]]). If you have more than one type of sheet, the first one in your inventory will be consumed and the respective mount obtained. Also, you'll need one [[Beer Tap]] for each Barrel mount. When obtaining this mount, you receive the following message:
{{Server Message|It's tapped! You now own your very own blue rolling barrel! Have fun - it's an Orger tradition}}
body.taming_method: Use a [[Beer Tap]] on a [[Super Cask]] while having a [[Decorative Blue Sheet]] in your inventory.

body.name: Battlefrazzle
body.taming_method: Use a [[Marinated Sturgeon]] on a [[Tamed Frazzlemaw]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6879|August 12, 2022}}.
body.name: Parade Horse
body.notes: A seasoned warrior knows how to make an entry, and so does his faithful companion: Fully armored! Saddle up your impressive Jousting Horse to charge into battle in style, gallop into the arena on the back of your striking Tourney Horse, and ride your distinguished Parade Horse through the streets of Thais to show off your chivalrous qualities. With a horse in full barding, nobody will ever rain on your parade again.

body.name: War Bear
body.notes:
Be aware that the [[Slingshot]] can break before you can obtain your War Bear.

body.notes: Incredible strength and smartness, an irrepressible will to survive, passionately hunting in groups. If these attributes apply to your character, we have found the perfect partner for you. Have a proper look at Snow Pelt, which stands loyally by its master's side in every situation. It is time to become the leader of the wolf pack!

body.name: Steel Bee
body.notes: If you are more interested in the achievements of science, you may enjoy a ride on the Steel Bee, one of the new insect-like flying machines. Even if you do not move around, the wings of these unusual vehicles are always in motion.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

There is a chance that the [[Wailing Widow]] eats the [[Sweet Smelling Bait]].

body.name: Zaoan Badger
body.notes: Badgers have been a staple of the Tibian fauna for a long time, and finally some daring souls have braved the challenge to tame some exceptional specimens - and succeeded! While the common badger you can encounter during your travels might seem like a rather unassuming creature, the Battle Badger, the Ether Badger, and the Zaoan Badger are fierce and mighty beasts, which are at your beck and call.

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Tempest
body.notes: Once a majestic and proud warhorse, the Tempest has fallen in a horrible battle many years ago. Driven by agony and pain, its spirit once again took possession of its rotten corpse to avenge its death. Stronger than ever, it seeks a master to join the battlefield, aiming for nothing but death and destruction.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Jade Lion
body.notes: Its roaring is piercing marrow and bone and can be heard over ten miles away. The Jade Lion is the undisputed ruler of its territory and no one messes with this animal. Show no fear and prove yourself worthy of its trust and you will get yourself a valuable companion for your adventures.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Dusk Pryer
body.notes: A magical fire burns inside these wolves. Bred as the faithful guardians for an eccentric wizard's tower, these creatures make for loyal companions during your travels. While not originally intended for riding, their sturdy frame makes the Dawn Strayer, Dusk Pryer and Snow Strider suitable mounts.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7458|September 15, 2023}}.
body.name: Doom Skull
body.notes: Skulls are the infernal heralds of untamed power. Bodies are obsolete when sinister forces animate your being. Embrace their presence and command the devastating might that awaits on the back of a grim Doom Skull.

body.name: Platesaurian
body.notes: It could be bought on Tibia.com from July 22, 2014 ([[Updates/10.51]]) {{OfficialNewsArchive|2905|until October 8, 2014}}.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com in a specific period of time.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7176|March 10, 2023}}.
body.name: Winterstride
body.notes: Tenacity, strength and loyalty are the hallmarks of a Frostbringer, a Winterstride or an Icebreacher. Those travelling through barren lands, pursuing goals in forbidding environments, or simply wanting a comrade for a lifetime should fall back on this stalwart companion.

body.name: White Lion (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Red Silk Flower]] on one of the [[White Lion]]s at the entrance of the [[Lion Sanctum]] ({{Mapper Coords|text=here|129.99|125.254|10|2|1|0.50.5}}).

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7016|November 25, 2022}}.
body.name: Ink Spotted Koi
body.notes: The vibrant colours and elegance of a Tangerine Flecked Koi, a Brass Speckled Koi, and an Ink Spotted Koi make them a fascinating sight to behold, and their boisterous nature and speed will make you the first to arrive wherever there are riches to gain. Wield your weapon as gracefully and effortlessly as your swimming companion glides through the water, and the two of you will make the perfect and most deadly pair.

body.name: Ursagrodon
body.notes:
Only obtainable when the island of [[Chyllfroest]] is accessible (normally from April to May). The [[Melting Horn]] needs to be used three consecutive times on the [[Half-Frozen Ursagrodon]]. First announced on {{OfficialNewsArchive|2706|March 21, 2014}}.
{{Seealso|Melting Horn/Statistics}}
body.taming_method: Use a [[Melting Horn]] on a [[Half-Frozen Ursagrodon]].

body.name: Void Watcher
body.notes: If you are looking for a vigilant and faithful companion, look no further! Glide through every realm and stare into the darkest abyss on the back of a Void Watcher. They already know everything about you anyway for they have been watching you from the shadows!
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6188|June 11, 2021}}.
body.name: Dandelion
body.notes: Born from the depths of the forest, where flora and fauna intertwine in mysterious ways, the Floral Beast is a colourful creature that is sure to turn some heads. The Hyacinth, Peony, and Dandelion mount are loyal companions that will safely carry you through their natural habitat of the woods, or lands unknown to them.

body.name: Noble Lion (Mount)
body.notes: It is a tamed [[Noble Lion]].
body.taming_method: Use [[The Lion's Heart]] on a [[Noble Lion]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7855|May 17, 2024}}.
body.name: Glacier Wyrm
body.notes: These beings are as ancient as the volcanoes, mountains, and caves of Tibia and despite their formidable presence, they skillfully navigate through the tiniest openings the surroundings may offer. Mount up on a [[Glacier Wyrm]], a [[Bog Tyrant]], or a [[Crimson Fang]] and zip to your next duel both swiftly and securely!

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7176|March 10, 2023}}.
body.name: Icebreacher
body.notes: Tenacity, strength and loyalty are the hallmarks of a Frostbringer, a Winterstride or an Icebreacher. Those travelling through barren lands, pursuing goals in forbidding environments, or simply wanting a comrade for a lifetime should fall back on this stalwart companion.

body.name: Spirit of Purity
body.taming_method: Use four [[Spiritual Horseshoe]]s obtained through the various bosses of the [[Rotten Blood Quest]], after defeating [[Bakragore]] at least once.

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3061|January 21, 2015}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Emerald Waccoon
body.notes: Waccoons are cuddly creatures that love nothing more than to be petted and snuggled! Share a hug, ruffle the fur of the Emerald Waccoon and scratch it behind its ears to make it happy.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Eventide Nandu
body.notes:
These birds have a strong maternal instinct since their fledglings are completely dependent on their parents for protection. Do not expect them to abandon their brood only because they are carrying you around. In fact, if you were to separate them from their chick, the Savanna Ostrich, Coral Rhea and Eventide Nandu would turn into vicious beings, so don't even try it!
{{Seealso|Benevolent Eventide Nandu}}

body.name: Shock Head (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Nightmare Horn]] on a [[Shock Head]].

body.history:
This mount was {{OfficialNewsArchive|1848|a special offer}} that could be obtained by buying 180 or 360 days of premium time between September 30 and October 13, 2011. Buying the premium time only let you assign this mount to one [[character]]. It is possible to follow the offical FAQ made by '''CM Tjured''' {{Post|31230560|here}}.

This mount has been available in the [[Store]] since {{OfficialNewsArchive|4262|September 15, 2017}}.

[[File:Shadow Draptor (Creature).gif|thumb|left|Unused creature version]]
body.name: Shadow Draptor
body.notes: A wild, ancient creature, which had been hiding in the depths of the shadows for a very long time, has been spotted in Tibia again! The almighty Shadow Draptor has returned and only the bravest Tibians can control such a beast!
body.taming_method: Adding [[Premium Time]] during a specific date or buying it via the [[Store]].

body.name: Mutated Abomination
body.notes: To be able to get this mount you must have completed [[The Cradle of Monsters Quest]].
body.taming_method: Use the lever in the room south of [[Geoffray]] in [[Doctor Marrow]]'s laboratory after defeating [[The Monster]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4649|June 08, 2018}} while it had been implemented one day before that, with [[Updates/11.00#11.75.6980|Update 11.75.6980]].
body.name: Ebony Tiger
body.notes: It is said that in ancient times, the sabre-tooth tiger was already used as a mount by elder warriors of Svargrond. As seafaring began to expand, this noble big cat was also transported to other regions in Tibia. Influenced by the new environment and climatic changes, the fur of the Ebony Tiger has developed its extraordinary colouring over several generations.

body.name: Racing Bird
body.notes: Like all extra content (outfits, mounts zones, etc.) you need a premium account to use mounts, even after being tamed.<noinclude><gallery mode="nolines">File:Teaser 2 Racing Bird.png|[[Racing Bird]]</gallery></noinclude>
body.taming_method: Use a [[Carrot on a Stick]] on a [[Terror Bird]].

body.history: Despite being implemented with [[Updates/10.94|Update 10.94]], this mount was added to the [[Store]] only on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3612|June 10, 2016}}.
body.name: Reed Lurker
body.notes: You are intrigued by tortoises and would love to throne on a tortoise shell when travelling the Tibian wilderness? The Reed Lurker might become your new trustworthy companion then, which will transport you safely and even carry you during combat.

body.name: Green Rolling Barrel
body.notes:
Its achievement is shared with the other Rolling Barrel Mounts ([[Red Rolling Barrel|Red]] and [[Blue Rolling Barrel|Blue]]). If you have more than one type of sheet, the first one in your inventory will be consumed and the respective mount obtained. Also, you'll need one [[Beer Tap]] for each Barrel mount. When obtaining this mount, you receive the following message:
{{Server Message|It's tapped! You now own your very own green rolling barrel! Have fun - it's an Orger tradition}}
body.taming_method: Use a [[Beer Tap]] on a [[Super Cask]] while having a [[Decorative Green Sheet]] in your inventory.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7167|March 10, 2023}}.

body.history: It can be bought since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]].
body.name: Death Crawler
body.notes: The Death Crawler is a scorpion that has surpassed the natural boundaries of its own kind. Way bigger, stronger and faster than ordinary scorpions, it makes a perfect companion for fearless heroes and explorers. Just be careful of his poisonous sting when you mount it.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6188|June 11, 2021}}.
body.name: Hyacinth (Mount)
body.notes: Born from the depths of the forest, where flora and fauna intertwine in mysterious ways, the Floral Beast is a colourful creature that is sure to turn some heads. The Hyacinth, Peony, and Dandelion mount are loyal companions that will safely carry you through their natural habitat of the woods, or lands unknown to them.

body.name: Stampor (Mount)
body.notes:
Say "Stampor" to Chondur and he will give you the mount after a few seconds.<noinclude><gallery navigation="true" mode="nolines">
File:Teaser 2 Stampor.png|[[Stampor (Mount)]]
</gallery></noinclude>
body.taming_method: Give 30 [[Hollow Stampor Hoof]], 50 [[Stampor Horn]] and 100 [[Stampor Talons]] to [[Chondur]] in [[Meriana]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|5198|November 18, 2019}}.
body.name: Floating Sage
body.notes: These creatures are Floating Savants whose mind has been warped and bent to focus their extraordinary mental capabilities on one single goal: to do their master's bidding. Instead of being filled with an endless pursuit of knowledge, their live is now one of continuous thralldom and serfhood. The Floating Sage, the Floating Scholar and the Floating Augur are at your disposal.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4994|May 10, 2019}} while it had been implemented one month before that, with [[Updates/12.12.8341|Update 12.12.8341]].
body.name: Swamp Crocovile
body.notes: To the keen observer, the crocovile is clearly a relative of the crocodile, albeit their look suggests an even more aggressive nature. While it is true that the power of its massive and muscular body can not only crush enemies dead but also break through any gate like a battering ram, a crocovile is, above all, a steadfast companion showing unwavering loyalty to its owner.

body.name: Finished Dark Percht Sleigh
body.notes: It's the final upgrade after the [[Dark Percht Sleigh]] and its [[Dark Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant]]. Upgrading the mount is only possible when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active and one year after getting the Variant mount.
body.taming_method: Ask [[Frosty]] to upgrade a [[Dark Percht Sleigh Variant]] by delivering another [[Percht Skull]] to him.

body.name: Rabbit Rickshaw
body.notes: Your lower back worsens with every trip you spend on the back of your mount and you are looking for a more comfortable alternative to travel through the lands? Say no more! The Rabbit Rickshaw comes with two top-performing hares that never get tired thanks to the brand new and highly innovative propulsion technology. Just keep some back-up carrots in your pocket and you will be fine!

body.history: It can be bought since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]].
body.name: Nethersteed
body.notes: Once a majestic and proud warhorse, the Nethersteed has fallen in a horrible battle many years ago. Driven by agony and pain, its spirit once again took possession of its rotten corpse to avenge its death. Stronger than ever, it seeks a master to join the battlefield, aiming for nothing but death and destruction.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3836|December 23, 2016}}, but it was implemented a couple of months earlier on October 25, 2016 with [[Updates/11.01.3987|11.01.3987]] and [[Updates/10.99|10.99]].
body.name: Dreadhare
body.notes: Do you like fluffy bunnies but think they are too small? Do you admire the majesty of stags and their antlers but are afraid of their untameable wilderness? Do not worry, the mystic creature Dreadhare consolidates the best qualities of both animals. Hop on its backs and enjoy the ride.

body.name: Benevolent Coral Rhea
body.notes:
This is one of the first mounts bought with [[Tibia Coins]] that are assigned to all characters on the account.

This mount could be bought in the Store from April 17 till April 31, 2020. From June 2020 onwards, a new version of this mount - [[Coral Rhea]] - is available in the [[Store]] which will be assigned only to the character used when purchasing the mount.

The entire proceeds gained from the sale of this and the other benevolent mounts, which was {{OfficialNewsArchive|5595|about 166,000€}}, went towards the COVID-19 Solidarity Response Fund of the World Health Organization (WHO).
body.taming_method: Buy it from the [[Store]] in a specific period of time.

body.name: Bright Percht Sleigh Variant
body.notes:
You can only upgrade one year after getting the basic Bright Percht Sleigh. Upgrading to the Variant mount has no benefit other than receiving a new mount with a slightly different visual, however, this is necessary for the [[Finished Bright Percht Sleigh|finished]] improvement of the mount. 

Upgrading the mount is only possible when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.
body.taming_method: Ask [[Frosty]] to upgrade a [[Bright Percht Sleigh]] by delivering another [[Percht Skull]] to him.

body.name: Flame Bear
body.notes:
A bolt of living fire, a beast forged from nature's fury. The Flame Bear burns with unending hunger - a creature of ash and embers. Ride the inferno and become one with the primal force that sparked it all.

Purchasing this [[Mounts|Mount]] through the [[Burning Ash Bundle]] can save you 360 [[Tibia Coins]] instead of buying each of the items separately.

body.name: Sparkion (Mount)
body.notes: Obtaining it is one third of the requirements for the [[Vortex Tamer]] [[achievement]].

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.51|Update 10.51]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Tombstinger
body.notes: The Tombstinger is a scorpion that has surpassed the natural boundaries of its own kind. Way bigger, stronger and faster than ordinary scorpions, it makes a perfect companion for fearless heroes and explorers. Just be careful of his poisonous sting when you mount it.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3039|December 18, 2014}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Shadow Hart
body.notes: Treat your character to a new travelling companion with a gentle nature and an impressive antler: The noble Shadow Hart will carry you through the deepest snow.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7458|September 15, 2023}}.
body.name: Corpsefire Skull
body.notes: Skulls are the infernal heralds of untamed power. Bodies are obsolete when sinister forces animate your being. Embrace their presence and command the devastating might that awaits on the back of an eerie Corpsefire Skull!

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6879|August 12, 2022}}.
body.name: Tourney Horse
body.notes: A seasoned warrior knows how to make an entry, and so does his faithful companion: Fully armored! Saddle up your impressive Jousting Horse to charge into battle in style, gallop into the arena on the back of your striking Tourney Horse, and ride your distinguished Parade Horse through the streets of Thais to show off your chivalrous qualities. With a horse in full barding, nobody will ever rain on your parade again.

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.60 (2)|Update 10.60 (2)]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Tundra Rambler
body.notes: With its thick, shaggy hair, the Tundra Rambler will keep you warm even in the chilly climate of the Ice Islands. Due to its calm and peaceful nature, it is not letting itself getting worked up easily.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Plumfish
body.notes: It can be bought since June 8, 2015.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Azudocus
body.notes: It could be bought on Tibia.com from July 22, 2014 ([[Updates/10.51]]) {{OfficialNewsArchive|2905|until October 8, 2014}}.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com in a specific period of time.

body.name: Festive Snowman
body.notes: When the nights are getting longer and freezing wind brings driving snow into the land, snowmen rise and shine on every corner. Lately, a peaceful, arcane creature has found shelter in one of them and used its magical power to call the Festive Snowman into being. Wrap yourself up well and warmly and jump on the back of your new frosty companion.

body.history:
Previously known as ''Red Manta'' by players. While this mount was added to the game with the [[Updates/9.7|Update 9.7]], it was only obtainable during {{OfficialNewsArchive|2400|a special offer}} by buying a package of 6 or 12 [[Premium Scroll]]s between May 31 and June 14, 2013. Buying the premium scrolls package only let you assign this mount to one [[character]]. It is possible to follow the offical FAQ made by '''CM Mirade''' {{Post|34998220|here}}.

This mount has been available in the [[Store]] since {{OfficialNewsArchive|4167|July 14, 2017}}. [[File:Crimson Ray Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Crimson Ray Premium Scroll offer.]]
body.name: Crimson Ray
body.notes: Have you ever dreamed of gliding through the air on the back of a winged creature? With its deep red wings, the majestic Crimson Ray is a worthy mount for courageous heroes. Feel like a king on its back as you ride into your next adventure.
body.taming_method: Adding [[Premium Time]] during a specific date or buying it via the [[Store]].

body.name: Finished Cold Percht Sleigh
body.notes: It's the final upgrade after the [[Cold Percht Sleigh]] and its [[Cold Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant]]. Upgrading the mount is only possible when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.
body.taming_method: Ask [[Frosty]] to upgrade a [[Cold Percht Sleigh Variant]] by delivering another [[Percht Skull]] to him.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4352|October 31, 2017}}, however it was implemented a couple of months earlier with [[Updates/11.45.5528|Update 11.45]].
body.name: Cave Tarantula
body.notes: It is said that the Cave Tarantula was born long before Banor walked the earth of Tibia. While its parents died in the war against the cruel hordes sent by Brog and Zathroth, their child survived by hiding in skulls of burned enemies. It never left its hiding spot and as it grew older, the skulls merged into its body. Now, it is fully-grown and thirsts for revenge.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Muffled Snowman
body.notes: When the nights are getting longer and freezing wind brings driving snow into the land, snowmen rise and shine on every corner. Lately, a peaceful, arcane creature has found shelter in one of them and used its magical power to call the Muffled Snowman into being. Wrap yourself up well and warmly and jump on the back of your new frosty companion.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|5630|July 10, 2019}}.
body.name: Scruffy Hyaena
body.notes: The Cunning Hyaena, Scruffy Hyaena and Voracious Hyaena are highly social animals and loyal companions to whomever is able to befriend them. Coming from sun-soaked places, they prefer a warm climate, but are able to cope in other environments as well.

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3061|January 21, 2015}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Ringtail Waccoon
body.notes: Waccoons are cuddly creatures that love nothing more than to be petted and snuggled! Share a hug, ruffle the fur of the Ringtail Waccoon and scratch it behind its ears to make it happy.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Rented Horse
body.notes:
Rent a [[Horse]] from [[Appaloosa]] at the Venore horse station or from [[Palomino]] at the Thais horse station for 500 gold. A rented horse lasts for 24 [[Real Life]] hours. It is the only non-[[Market]] mount available for [[Free Account]] players, but it is temporary. To get this mount, the server must have [[Horse Station World Change|triggered the world change]] involving the rounding up of escaped horses.

There are three rented horse variants:

body.name: Sea Devil
body.notes: If the Sea Devil moves its fins, it generates enough air pressure that it can even float over land. Its numerous eyes allow it to quickly detect dangers even in confusing situations and eliminate them with one powerful bite. If you watch your fingers, you are going to be good friends.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3061|January 21, 2015}}, it has been available for purchase.

body.notes: Waccoons are cuddly creatures that love nothing more than to be petted and snuggled! Share a hug, ruffle the fur of the Night Waccoon and scratch it behind its ears to make it happy.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Lady Bug
body.notes: You can find the [[Ladybug]]'s at [[Hive]], in [[Quirefang]].

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on February 26, 2016.
body.name: Leafscuttler
body.notes: You are fascinated by insectoid creatures and can picture yourself riding one during combat or just for travelling? The Leafscuttler will carry you through the Tibian wilderness with ease.

body.history: Despite being implemented with [[Updates/10.94|Update 10.94]], this mount was added to the [[Store]] only on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3612|June 10, 2016}}.
body.name: Mould Shell
body.notes: You are intrigued by tortoises and would love to throne on a tortoise shell when travelling the Tibian wilderness? The Mould Shell might become your new trustworthy companion then, which will transport you safely and even carry you during combat.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3955|March 10, 2017}}, but the sprites were already released with [[Updates/11.10|Update 11.10]]<!-- or before that -->.
body.name: Shadow Sphinx
body.notes: Ride a Shadow Sphinx on your way through ancient chambers and tombs and have a loyal friend by your side while fighting countless mummies and other creatures.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on April 28, 2017, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Ember Saurian
body.notes: Thousands of years ago, its ancestors ruled the world. Only recently, it found its way into Tibia. The Ember Saurian has been spotted in a sea of flames and fire deep down in the depths of Kazordoon.

body.history: It is the first store bought mount to offer the colourisable ability. </br> [[File:Gorgon_Hydra_Banner.jpg]]
body.name: Gorgon Hydra
body.notes: The Gorgon Hydra is a formidable mount, a true powerhouse! A single mouth could easily rend any enemy asunder, and with three of them, it could consume entire villages. Embrace fear, invite hatred, and ride this majestic beast!</br></br>[[File:Gorgon_Hydra_Artwork.jpg|500px]]

body.name: Neon Sparkid
body.notes: Taming this creature is one third of the requirements for the [[Vortex Tamer]] [[achievement]].
body.taming_method: [[Use]] a [[Crackling Egg]] and you will automatically receive it.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6614|March 11, 2022}}.
body.name: Topaz Shrine
body.notes: The famous Wandering Shrines were first raised by the nomad people of the Zaoan steppe. Their exceptional craftsmanship, combining architectonic features with living animals, is acknowledged even far beyond the continent of Zao. These spiritual companions will give you the opportunity to regain your strength during long and exciting journeys.

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.60 (2)|Update 10.60 (2)]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Golden Dragonfly
body.notes: If you are more interested in the achievements of science, you may enjoy a ride on the Golden Dragonfly, one of the new insect-like flying machines. Even if you do not move around, the wings of these unusual vehicles are always in motion.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Mystic Jaguar (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use a [[Polished Idol of Tukh]] on a [[Mystic Jaguar]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8236|February 21, 2025}}.
body.name: Night Locust
body.notes: Born from the buzzing chaos of nature's most untamed corners, the [[Night Locust]], [[Leaf Locust]], and [[Pearl Locust]] are said to be harbingers of fortune for their allies and heralds of despair for their foes. With their vibrant wings and shimmering shells, these eerie yet majestic creatures are exceptional mounts for adventurers who thrive in the wilds.

body.name: Tidal Seawater Predator
body.notes: Acquired through the [[Task Board#Hunting Task Shop|task board]] by exchanging '''145,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}} [[Task Board#Hunting Task Points|Hunting Task Points]].
body.taming_method: Acquired through the [[Task Board#Hunting Task Shop|task board]] by exchanging '''145,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}} [[Task Board#Hunting Task Points|Hunting Task Points]].

body.name: Bright Percht Sleigh
body.notes:
The Sleigh can be upgraded to a [[Bright Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant form]].

It can only be obtained when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3176|April 30, 2015}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Venompaw
body.notes:
Rumour has it that many years ago elder witches had gathered to hold a magical feast high up in the mountains. They had crossbred Venompaw to easily conquer rocky canyons and deep valleys. Nobody knows what happened on their way up but only the mount has been seen ever since.
[[File:Standing Venompaw.gif|thumb|left|Idle Animation]]
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Guardian Lion
body.notes: The Guardian Lion is both playful and majestic, radiating a splendour that cows enemies at first sight. Its very presence is a warning. Should that warning be ignored, this noble beast will unleash merciless fury upon all who threaten its master.

body.name: Battle Werewolf
body.notes: As the butcher of the living, your name is terror. Ride into battle on the snarling back of a Battle Werewolf, painting the earth red in your wake. Let the sun-dwellers tremble, your legend will eclipse their light.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4748|September 14, 2018}} while it had been implemented 10 days before that, with [[Updates/11.88.7288|Update 11.88]].
body.name: Tawny Owl
body.notes: Owls have always been a symbol of mystery, magic and wisdom in Tibian myths and fairy tales. Having one of these enigmatic creatures of the night as a trustworthy companion provides you with a silent guide whose ever-watchful eyes will cut through the shadows, help you navigate the darkness and unravel great secrets.

body.notes: Treat your character to a new travelling companion with a gentle nature and an impressive antler: The noble Black Stag will carry you through the deepest snow.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Bunny Dray
body.notes: Your lower back worsens with every trip you spend on the back of your mount and you are looking for a more comfortable alternative to travel through the lands? Say no more! The Bunny Dray comes with two top-performing hares that never get tired thanks to the brand new and highly innovative propulsion technology. Just keep some back-up carrots in your pocket and you will be fine!

body.history:
* Originally, it could be purchased for 1,250 {{Icon|Tournament Coin}} and would become available for all characters of the account.
* As of the {{OfficialNewsArchive|6180|Sunsetting}} of [[Tournaments]], on [[Updates/13.14.13146|March 21, 2023]] it became available to players using [[Tibia Coins]].
body.name: Cerberus Champion
body.notes:
A fierce and grim guardian of the underworld has risen to fight side by side with the bravest warriors in order to send evil creatures into the realm of the dead. The three headed Cerberus Champion is constantly baying for blood and using its sharp fangs it easily rips apart even the strongest armour and shield.

When not walking, Cerberus Champion will behave like this: [[File:Cerberus Champion (Standing).gif]]

body.history: Since [[Updates/10.60 (2)|Update 10.60 (2)]], it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Glacier Vagabond
body.notes: With its thick, shaggy hair, the Glacier Vagabond will keep you warm even in the chilly climate of the Ice Islands. Due to its calm and peaceful nature, it is not letting itself getting worked up easily.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Vortexion
body.notes: Taming this creature is one third of the requirements for the [[Vortex Tamer]] [[achievement]].
body.taming_method: [[Use]] a [[Menacing Egg]] and you will automatically receive it.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|5630|July 10, 2019}}.
body.name: Voracious Hyaena
body.notes: The Cunning Hyaena, Scruffy Hyaena and Voracious Hyaena are highly social animals and loyal companions to whomever is able to befriend them. Coming from sun-soaked places, they prefer a warm climate, but are able to cope in other environments as well.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4649|June 08, 2018}} while it had been implemented one day before that, with [[Updates/11.00#11.75.6980|Update 11.75.6980]].
body.name: Jungle Tiger
body.notes: It is said that in ancient times, the sabre-tooth tiger was already used as a mount by elder warriors of Svargrond. As seafaring began to expand, this noble big cat was also transported to other regions in Tibia. Influenced by the new environment and climatic changes, the fur of the Jungle Tiger has developed its extraordinary colouring over several generations.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3357|October 31, 2015}}.
body.name: Slagsnare
body.notes: The Slagsnare has external characteristics of different breeds. It is assumed that his brain is also composed of many different species, which makes it completely unpredictable. Only few have managed to approach this creature unharmed and only the best could tame it.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6307|September 10, 2021}}.
body.name: Rustwurm
body.notes: The Bogwurm, Gloomwurm, and Rustwurm belong to a little known subset of the dragon family, and usually live out their lives in habitats far away from human interaction. Them being cunning hunters, and their keen sense of perception make these wurms great companions for whomever can locate and tame them.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6697|May 13, 2022}}.
body.name: Cinnamon Ibex
body.notes: No mountain is too high, no wall too steep to climb for the agile Poppy, Mint and Cinnamon Ibex. They keep their balance on the thinnest of ledges, so you will never stumble, slip or go flying off the edges. Moreover, these sturdy fellows certainly know how to make an entrance as they dive down from the highest peaks and attack opponents with their impressive horns. And if you dare to call them a wild goat, they might kick you with their legs.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4236|August 11, 2017}}, but it was already implemented a few weeks earlier with the [[Updates/11.40|Summer Update 2017]].
body.name: Blazing Unicorn
body.notes: The Blazing Unicorn lives in a deep rivalry with its cousin the Arctic Unicorn. Even though they were born in completely different areas, they somehow share the same bloodline. The eternal battle between fire and ice continues. Who will win? Crystal blue vs. tangerine! The choice is yours!
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Kingly Deer
body.notes: None.
body.taming_method: Use a [[Golden Fir Cone]] or a [[Music Box]] on an [[Enraged White Deer]].

body.name: Undead Cavebear (Mount)
body.notes:
Mount of the [[Skeletons|skeleton]] kind.
<noinclude><gallery mode="nolines">File:Teaser 2 Undead Cavebear.png|[[Undead Cavebear]]</gallery></noinclude>
body.taming_method: Use a [[Maxilla Maximus]] on an [[Undead Cavebear]].

body.name: Gryphon (Mount)
body.taming_method: Use [[The Regalia of Suon]] on a [[Gryphon]] while wearing a [[Gryphon Mask]].

body.name: Jaracal (Mount)
body.notes: To tame a [[Jaracal (Mount)|Jaracal]] you must use a [[Skewered Fish]] on a [[Jaracal]].

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6614|March 11, 2022}}.
body.name: Obsidian Shrine
body.notes: The famous Wandering Shrines were first raised by the nomad people of the Zaoan steppe. Their exceptional craftsmanship, combining architectonic features with living animals, is acknowledged even far beyond the continent of Zao. These spiritual companions will give you the opportunity to regain your strength during long and exciting journeys.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4236|August 11, 2017}}, but it was already implemented a few weeks earlier with the [[Updates/11.40|Summer Update 2017]].
body.name: Prismatic Unicorn
body.notes: Legend has it that a mare and a stallion once reached the end of a rainbow and decided to stay there. Influenced by the mystical power of the rainbow, the mare gave birth to an exceptional foal: Not only the big, strong horn on its forehead but the unusual colouring of its hair makes the Prismatic Unicorn a unique mount in every respect.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Savanna Ostrich
body.notes:
These birds have a strong maternal instinct since their fledglings are completely dependent on their parents for protection. Do not expect them to abandon their brood only because they are carrying you around. In fact, if you were to separate them from their chick, the Savanna Ostrich, Coral Rhea and Eventide Nandu would turn into vicious beings, so don't even try it!
{{Seealso|Benevolent Savanna Ostrich}}

body.name: Tin Lizzard
body.notes:
The [[Tin Lizzard (Object)|Tin Lizzard object]] is located in the lowest floor of the [[Factory Quarter]] north-east area, {{Mapper Coords|128.161|122.15|10|2|text=here}}.
Note that the [[Tin Key]] may break when used. The Tin Lizzard may also break, but the key is kept. The Lizzard will repawn a few hours later. File:Teaser 2 Tin Lizzard.png|Tin Lizzard - update teaser
body.taming_method: Use a [[Tin Key]] on a [[Tin Lizzard (Object)|stationary Tin Lizzard]].

body.name: Reliable Ram
body.notes: Obtained by using {{Ilink|Bunch of Turnips}} [[Bunch of Turnips]] on a Ram on Targuna.
body.taming_method: Use [[Bunch of Turnips]] on a Ram on Targuna.

body.history: This mount was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7331|June 09, 2023}}.
body.name: Boisterous Bull
body.notes: Do you love the fresh scent of country air and feel a sense of warmth when you think of a rustic farm? Or do you yearn to harness the raw power of a colossal four-legged friend? If so, then look no further than the Boisterous Bull, the Surly Steer, or the Obstinate Ox. These mounts will be sure to satisfy your needs.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on December 23, 2015.
body.name: Cinderhoof
body.notes:
If you are more of an imp than an angel, you may prefer riding out on a Cinderhoof to scare fellow Tibians on their festive strolls. Its devilish mask, claw-like hands and sharp hooves makes it the perfect companion for any daring adventurer who likes to stand out.
[[File:Idle Cinderhoof.gif|thumb|left|Idle Animation]]

body.history: Since {{OfficialNewsArchive|3276|August 3, 2015|}}, it has been available for purchase.
body.name: Noctungra
body.notes: Get yourself a mighty travelling companion with broad shoulders and a gentle heart. Noctungra is a physically imposing creature that is much more peaceful than its relatives, Tiquanda's wild kongras, and will carry you safely wherever you ask it to go.
body.taming_method: Buying it on Tibia.com or via the [[Store]].

body.name: Brass Speckled Koi
body.notes: The vibrant colours and elegance of a Tangerine Flecked Koi, a Brass Speckled Koi, and an Ink Spotted Koi make them a fascinating sight to behold, and their boisterous nature and speed will make you the first to arrive wherever there are riches to gain. Wield your weapon as gracefully and effortlessly as your swimming companion glides through the water, and the two of you will make the perfect and most deadly pair.

body.name: Crystal Wolf (Mount)
body.notes:
To obtain this mount, use a [[Diapason]] on a [[Crystal Wolf]]. Note: The [[Diapason]] has a chance of breaking when used.
The mounts Crystal Wolf and [[War Horse]] were chosen by players in {{OfficialNewsArchive|1596|a poll}}. The mount emits a small amount (around the same amount like [[Frozen Starlight]]) of blue-green light. Crystal Wolf mount.png

body.name: Jungle Saurian
body.notes:
Thousands of years ago, its ancestors ruled the world. Only recently, it found its way into Tibia. The Jungle Saurian likes to hide in dense wood and overturned trees.
[[File:Saurian Mounts.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]

body.name: Dark Percht Sleigh
body.notes:
The Sleigh can be upgraded to a [[Dark Percht Sleigh Variant|Variant form]].

It can only be obtained when the [[Winterlight Solstice]] event is active.

body.history: The [[Blazebringer]] mount could be obtained by many participants of [[The Lightbearer]] 2010 event even if they did not light all 10 basins because there was a bug which made players unable to get into reward room, so [[CipSoft]] decided to open both rooms for all players that received the torch and were above level 35.
body.name: Blazebringer
body.notes:
You do not need the [[Deed of Ownership (Book)]] that you receive from [[The Lightbearer]] event to receive this mount. Buying this item from other players will have no effect!
<noinclude><gallery mode="nolines">
File:Teaser 2 Blazebringer.png|Blazebringer as seen in an [[Updates/8.7|Update 8.7]] teaser screenshot.
</gallery><noinclude>
body.taming_method: If you have lit all 10 basins on a successful [[Lightbearer]] event, you can ask [[Santa Claus]] for a ''very special present'' to receive this [[mount]].

body.name: Benevolent Eventide Nandu
body.notes:
This is one of the first mounts bought with [[Tibia Coins]] that are assigned to all characters on the account.

This mount could be bought in the Store from April 17 till April 31, 2020. From June 2020 onwards, a new version of this mount - [[Eventide Nandu]] - is available in the [[Store]] which will be assigned only to the character used when purchasing the mount.

The entire proceeds gained from the sale of this and the other benevolent mounts, which was {{OfficialNewsArchive|5595|about 166,000€}}, went towards the COVID-19 Solidarity Response Fund of the World Health Organization (WHO).
body.taming_method: Buy it from the [[Store]] in a specific period of time.

body.name: Batcat
body.notes:
Rumour has it that many years ago elder witches had gathered to hold a magical feast high up in the mountains. They had crossbred Batcat to easily conquer rocky canyons and deep valleys. Nobody knows what happened on their way up but only the mount has been seen ever since.
[[File:Standing Batcat.gif|thumb|left|Standing Animation]]

body.notes: Incredible strength and smartness, an irrepressible will to survive, passionately hunting in groups. It is time to become the leader of the wolf pack!

body.name: Toxic Toad
body.notes:
For centuries, humans and monsters have dumped their garbage in the swamps around Venore. The combination of old, rusty weapons, stale mana and broken runes have turned some of the swamp dwellers into gigantic frogs. Benefit from those mutations and make the Toxic Toad a faithful mount for your adventures even beyond the bounds of the swamp.
